fact: The head of the Real Estate Publicity and Notarisation Authority says property registration applications can be submitted manually or electronically through an electronic application, with documents uploaded online.

Ahram Online reports the Real Estate Registration and Notarization Authority's New Alamein office, linked by a G2G digital hub to the New Urban Communities Authority, lets all text, digital, spatial and licensing data on land and units in the new communities be retrieved under Law 177 of 2022.

fact: On 17 July 2025 Prime Minister Madbouly inaugurated the Real Estate Registry and Notarization Complex in New Alamein, launching a G2G integration system between the Justice Ministry's Real Estate Registry and Notarization Authority and the New Urban Communities Authority in 16 real estate registry offices in new cities, enabling retrieval of text, digital, spatial and licensing data on land, properties and units.
